description: Per-agency multi-primary image source registry. v2 rewrite 2026-06-17 based on 4 phases of deep-research verification. Each agency has a `primaries: [...]` array of verified-license sources, tried in order. Resolver chain: tier_1 (agency primaries) → tier_2_institutional (museums/archives) → wikimedia_commons (failover). See scripts/IMAGE-PIPELINE.md §'Source-resolution order' and memory `reference_agency_primary_archives.md`.

license_compatibility.policy: Per ADR-047, only allowed license types may be ingested as Tier 1 / Tier 2 sources. Excluded license types must NOT auto-fetch — either skip the source or require per-image manual permission flow. Wrong license is worse than missing source.

primaries.notes: Primary endpoint for all NASA missions + co-managed missions (DART, OSIRIS-REx, MER, Phoenix, Magellan, Mariner 9, Hubble crops). Reference implementation in scripts/lib/agency-resolver.mjs. Threshold left at default (0.66) — earlier attempt to loosen to 0.5 was based on a wrong assumption: PIA21944 was thought to be a legit Hayabusa frame and gate-rejected as false-negative; verification 2026-06-17 confirmed PIA21944 is actually a Pluto/New Horizons image and gate-rejection was correct. NASA images-api fuzzy-keyword search returns tangential picks; gate filtering at 0.66 is the right behavior.

Self-branded 'Official Roscosmos Photos', joined 2015. ~27 albums covering launches/ISS/missions. NSID 130679727@N03. flickrPublicScrape uses flickr.com/search/?user_id=<nsid>&text=... Titles are mostly Cyrillic; minimal-proper-noun queries (e.g. 'Soyuz' not 'Soyuz spacecraft launch') give the gate the best shot. KNOWN LIMITATION: title pairing via regex is unreliable — Flickr search-form data echoes the query string into a `"title":"..."` JSON field which gets falsely paired with the first photo. Threshold 1.0 (strict) suppresses most false-positives at the cost of more Commons fallbacks. Proper fix: parse the embedded modelExport JSON. Tracked as registry follow-up.
Official press site, intermittently dark since 2022. Try after Flickr exhaustion.

primaries.notes: Official English-site Pictures section, paginated thumbnail grid (index_10538194_1.html, _2.html). License notice on site: 'Anyone who wants to mirror or copy the information appeared here at this site should first consult the webmaster to get written permisson' [sic]. **Do NOT auto-fetch** — this license is not ADR-047 compatible. Use for manual per-image permission flow only.

State media; image-license terms unverified; defer until clarified

primaries.notes: 5,507 images in 14 categories (Galaxies/Nebulae/Stars/Cosmology/Exoplanets/Quasars/Black Holes). CC BY 4.0 per esahubble.org/copyright/ — clearly attributable, active link required online. Exclusions: ESA/Hubble logo, music, code, scientific papers.

ESA central multimedia archive organized by directorate (Science & Exploration, Space Safety, Applications, Enabling & Support, Agency). Most images CC BY 4.0; check individual page. **KNOWN LIMITATION:** /ESA_Multimedia/Search?Type=I&q=... does NOT actually filter by query — returns recent uploads regardless. esaMultimediaScrape gets ~20% recall (only matches when query overlaps a currently-featured image). For reliable per-mission coverage, use sci.esa.int/web/<mission>/multimedia-gallery instead (separate lane, requires mission-slug mapping). Tracked as registry follow-up.

Per-mission gallery URLs. Substitute {mission} with mission slug (juice, bepicolombo, mars-express, rosetta, etc.). Central sci.esa.int/web/multimedia-gallery only surfaces Rosetta; must crawl per-mission. The sci.esa.int domain carries a maintenance notice — secondary to ESA_Multimedia.
ESA's official Flickr account — well-maintained but per-photo license varies. Try after esahubble + esa.int Multimedia.

primaries.scope_hint: NASA-shot SpaceX mission imagery (Crew Dragon Demo-2, CRS-*, SpaceX-launched NASA payloads)
primaries.notes: NASA-shot imagery of SpaceX missions is NASA-PD. Use this as the safe Tier-1 path for SpaceX-mission content.
**Grandfathered pre-2018 SpaceX Flickr uploads** were CC0/Public Domain. These remain safe to use. Wikimedia maintains the category.

known_dark_or_restricted.reason: **CRITICAL: License changed from CC0 to CC BY-NC 2.0 in mid-2018.** Current uploads are NonCommercial-only — incompatible with ADR-047. Do NOT fetch new content from here. Only pre-2018 uploads (mirrored on Wikimedia) are safe.
known_dark_or_restricted.history_note: Historical 2015-2018: CC0 / Public Domain (driven by EFF Parker Higgins + Techdirt public-pressure campaign). 2018 reversal to CC BY-NC 2.0 was silent. Wikimedia attempted contact, no reply (April 2026 note).

primaries.scope_hint: NASA-shot photos of Blue Origin hardware at NASA facilities (Blue Moon Mark 2 at JSC SVMF, MK1 in Thermal Vacuum Chamber A)
primaries.notes: NASA-PD per 17 U.S.C. §105 + NASA Brand Center policy. Safe Tier-1 source for NASA-credited BO hardware imagery. **Important: 'courtesy of Blue Origin' attribution = Blue Origin's rights, NOT NASA-PD — exclude.**

known_dark_or_restricted.reason: Phase 1C + 1D inconclusive (HTTP 429 rate-limits). Re-verify before adding.

ASI.label: Italian Space Agency / Agenzia Spaziale Italiana

primaries.notes: Italian agency, partner on DART (LICIACube). No public search API; press-release scrape only. License: CC BY (ASI Press Use).

SpaceIL.reason: All Beresheet imagery at spaceil.com/מדיה is © 2020 SpaceIL with NO open license declared. Israeli copyright default = all rights reserved. **No Tier-1 source available without per-image manual permission flow.**

IAI.reason: Every iai.co.il page: '© 2026 Israel Aerospace Industries. All rights reserved.' Terms of Use §5.2 explicitly prohibits reuse. Media Kit marked 'COMING SOON' (2026-06-17). No Tier-1 source.

USSF.reason: US Space Force OTV / X-37B imagery — not researched yet. Likely some imagery is DoD-PD-government via dvidshub.net but verification pending.

UAESA.reason: UAE Space Agency / Hope Probe imagery — not researched yet. Likely on uaespaceagency.ae but verification pending.

tier_2_institutional.label: Smithsonian Open Access
tier_2_institutional.coverage: National Air and Space Museum (Apollo, Mercury, Gemini, Skylab, Shuttle, Soviet artefacts) + 18 other Smithsonian museums
tier_2_institutional.notes: ~2.8M+ items released CC0 in Feb 2020. NASM Rights & Reproductions page tags CC0 vs 'Usage Conditions Apply' per item. Apollo 11 Command Module record verified live with CC0 mark. Threshold 1.0 (strict — 3/3 signals required) because NASM keyword-matches return many tangential collectibles for non-NASA missions (Slice B regression case).

tier_2_institutional.label: NARA Still Picture Branch Record Group 255
tier_2_institutional.coverage: 1M+ NASA/NACA photos 1903-2011 across 103 series. Mercury / Gemini / Lunar Orbiter / Apollo / Skylab / Shuttle / probes / observatories
tier_2_institutional.key_signup: Email Catalog_API@nara.gov with name + email; rate 10,000 req/month per key

tier_2_institutional.label: USGS Astrogeology / Astropedia
tier_2_institutional.coverage: Planetary mosaics: Mercury, Venus, Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, small bodies
tier_2_institutional.notes: PD-USGov per USGS copyright policy. **No press-photo search API** — Astropedia's data is served as Web Mapping Services (WMS/WFS) GIS tiles for mapping clients, not searchable JPEG records. The /search page is a SPA. For Orrery: use a curation file `static/data/agency-archive-curations/usgs.json` with known mosaic URLs per planet/site (e.g. Mars Global Mosaic for /mars surface anchor, Lunar Mosaic for /moon). pygeoapi at /pygeoapi/ is vector-only.

tier_2_institutional.label: European Southern Observatory (ESO) Public Images
tier_2_institutional.coverage: Astronomy / instruments — boundary case (not mission imagery per se), useful for some context shots
tier_2_institutional.notes: CC BY 4.0 by default per /copyright/ page. Carve-outs: logo protected, identifiable-person commercial restriction, no-endorsement clause.

tier_2_institutional.label: Apollo Lunar Surface Journal (ALSJ)
tier_2_institutional.coverage: Apollo missions — surface photographs + transcripts + audio + maps
tier_2_institutional.notes: NASA-hosted PD photos + editorial copyright on Jones commentary. No API. Per-asset license confirmation required before fetch.

tier_3_failover.label: Wikimedia Commons (failover only)
tier_3_failover.notes: **Last resort only — try after every Tier 1 + Tier 2 primary has been exhausted.** PR reviewers reject Commons-first additions per IMAGE-PIPELINE.md REGRESSION GUARD. When used, always note in sidecar that this is the Commons mirror, not the original.

resolver_chain: tier_2_institutional[*]  (only those with license-compatible coverage for the mission era/program)

exclusions_global.reason: NonCommercial incompatible with ADR-047 commercial-reuse posture
LIFE / AP / Reuters / Getty — commercial license required
Per-image manual flow only; not auto-fetchable
